meta.name: verify
meta.description: Drive an engine app headlessly in a pty, record a video of the whole verification, and open a summary page (video + timeline + checks) with pixel open.

copy.tagline: 驱动应用自动验证,录制全程视频并打开摘要页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要自动驱动应用运行并留下验证记录视频。
copy.tagline_en: Drive an app headlessly, record its verification, and open a summary page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate app verification and capture a video record

howto.what: Claude 会在 pty 里无头驱动引擎应用,录下整个验证过程的视频,并生成含视频、时间轴和检查表的摘要页,最后用 pixel open 打开它。
howto.when: 当你要求验证一个通过 kitty graphics protocol 渲染的引擎应用,或需要把整轮验证录下来时触发。

say.text: 帮我验证滚轮平移时光标是否锚定

say.note: 摘要页会列出每项检查的通过情况

howto.what_en: Claude drives your engine app headlessly in a pty, records the whole verification as a video, and opens a summary page (video, timeline, checks) with pixel open.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to verify an engine app that renders via the kitty graphics protocol, or when the whole verification needs to be recorded.

say_en.note: pixel open launches summary.html at the end
